transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, August 20. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Paternity test of child can be allowed in marital dispute: SC. If loyal, then why object: Court to woman 'Cannot afford any mistake': Harmanpreet rues India's lapses despite Pakistan win. In a nail-biting showdown at the Hockey World Cup, India triumphed over Pakistan, much to the delight of fans. Captain Harmanpreet Singh highlighted essential defensive weaknesses that need addressing for the challenges ahead. With praises from the coach regarding the team's attacking strategy and chances created, India now look forward to battle in the next round, where the competition will only intensify. 9 suffocate to death in sleep in Kolkata lodge fire, 5 Bangladeshis among them. 80 rescued from building with several guest houses, offices Meet 10-yr-old Hsu Ting-wei, winner of Silicon Valley invention award. In a remarkable showcase of talent, Taiwanese inventors made waves at the Silicon Valley International Festival. Among them, a ten-year-old prodigy captured prestigious awards with his innovative AI-powered electronic nose, designed to identify airborne chemical threats and health risks. The event highlighted the impressive achievement of Taiwanese participants, who collectively earned twenty-four gold medals, demonstrating the practical benefits of emerging technologies in daily life. NCERT recasts political science textbook panel; 4 with RSS links among 20 members. NCERT has recast the team for preparing political science textbooks for Classes XI and XII, with one of the two books slated to be ready by Nov. The 20-member panel includes faculty from JNU, DU, IGNOU and NLU Delhi, among others. At least four members have links, past or present, with organisations associated with RSS Pakistan whines, summons top diplomat over US envoy Gor's J and K remark in Srinagar. Pakistan on Wednesday summoned the US Charge d'Affaires in Islamabad and lodged a protest after US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor described Jammu and Kashmir as an "important part of India" during his visit to Srinagar on Wednesday. US issues details of new Green Card rules coming into effect from September 18. Beginning September 18, 2026, new rules from the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services will reshape the Green Card application landscape. Applicants will undergo a more rigorous public charge evaluation that now includes a broader range of public benefits. Additionally, previous cash assistance and long-term institutional stays will factor into decisions, significantly affecting family and employment-based immigration cases. Mehul Choksi's lawyer Vijay Aggarwal arrested in UK over sexual assault allegation. LONDON: Indian criminal lawyer Vijay Aggarwal, who represents fugitive diamond businessman Mehul Choksi, has been arrested in London and is in jail charged with four sexual assault offences on two women. Maine island bought by 27-year-old in 1964 later became wildlife sanctuary. Witch Island, previously inhabited by the infamous Anna Chittenden, referred to as the 'Witch of Wall Street', has transformed into a wildlife sanctuary. After her brief stay, Jane Sewall took on the responsibility of safeguarding the isle from irresponsible tourists. In 1986, Sewall gifted the island to the Maine Audubon Society, which is now overseen by the Coastal Rivers Conservation Trust. Disney built Disneyland around a family farm that refused a $90 million offer. For decades, the Fujishige family refused to sell their 58-acre farm in Anaheim, even as Disneyland and surrounding development transformed the area. Disney and other developers made repeated offers for the valuable land, but the family continued growing strawberries and vegetables. After years of pressure and a bitter fight with the city, the family finally agreed to sell in 1998, shortly before Hiroshi Fujishige died. The former farm later became the Toy Story parking lot at Disneyland. US tech firm asks court to block CEO who fired 900 in 79-second call. Better Home and Finance is suing former CEO Vishal Garg in a US court. The company seeks to block Garg from gathering shareholder support for his return. Garg allegedly violated securities laws by making misleading statements to regain his position. The board unanimously removed Garg after significant company losses and stock decline.

transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Bhopal Municipal Corporation Chairman Warns Commissioner Of 'Permanent Departure' Over Sudden Exit. A confrontation erupted at the Bhopal Municipal Corporation council meeting after Commissioner Sanskriti Jain suddenly left the House without informing Chairman Kishan Suryavanshi. The Madhya Pradesh Aviation Department has asked Bhopal district administration to identify land for two proposed helipads near the CM House and Mantralaya. BJP Leaders Await State In-Charge Appointments After National Team Announcement. Bhopal BJP leaders are awaiting the appointment of the party's new state in-charges after national president Nitin Nabin announced his team. Bhopal Municipal Corporation House Passes Property Leasing Proposals Amid Uproar, Traders Protest Licence Fee. Bhopal Municipal Corporation's council passed several proposals to lease vacant municipal properties amid uproar on Wednesday. TET Row: Teachers To Stage Protest At Jantar Mantar; Demand Waiver Of Exam Fees. Teachers affected by the Supreme Court's mandatory TET requirement plan to protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar on August 31. Kotwal reviews AIIMS Bhopal services, emphasizes patient-centred care. Even Minor Penalty Requires Departmental Enquiry If Employee Denies Charges: Madhya Pradesh High Court. Traders stage sit-in against BMC licence fee in Bhopal. High Court Quashes 2013 MBBS Admission Cancellation, Orders University To Issue Degree. The Jabalpur High Court has set aside the 2013 cancellation of MBBS student Shailja Pandey's admission and directed Rani Durgavati University to issue her marksheet and degree. Former President of India : Dr. Shanker Dayal Sharma. Behind Bhopal's Gen Alpha Protest, A 'Save DMS' Campaign Against Proposed DMS-KVS Merger. Bhopal: SSB jawan dies by suicide using service rifle. Very heavy rain alert for Madhya Pradesh, western UP; Delhi set for more showers. Dog Mask On, Man Claims Madhya Pradesh Sterilisation Drive All Bark, No Bite. Police step in after claims that 2 Kashmiris studying in Bhopal faced pressure to vacate rented home. Copper theft disrupts train ops, officials flag wider MP network. J and K Pharmacy Students Face Eviction Pressure In Bhopal, Cops Probe Claims. Pay farmers land compensation in 10 days, says HC.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Oil Holds Four-Day Gain With Iran Stalemate and Hormuz in Focus. Oil held a four-day run of gains as traders assessed the standoff in the Middle East between Iran and the US, with signs some crude is being shipped through the Strait of Hormuz to global markets. Government bond yields seen opening higher after hawkish RBI MPC minutes. Market participants expect the 10-year bond yield to rise 1-2 bps and the five-year yield 2-3 bps as traders factor in the possibility of a December rate hike Bessent Boosts Debt Buybacks After Yields Hit Multi-Decade Highs. The US Treasury unexpectedly announced it's ramping up buybacks of long-dated government debt, taking the action in the wake of yields on such securities hitting the highest levels in years. Sebi bars six from selling Dhenu Buildcon shares over alleged manipulation. Regulator alleges artificial fund rotation was used to boost company value and secure preference shares, while imposing restrictions on corporate actions Moderna's 177 percent Surge Burns Shorts in 'Painful' $5.5 Billion Loss. A record surge in Moderna Inc.'s shares delivered a $5.5 billion blow to short sellers who had bet that the vaccine maker's years-long slump would continue. BSE partners with MSCI to explore launch of index derivatives in India. BSE will explore futures and options contracts linked to MSCI indices, subject to regulatory approvals, as it seeks to deepen access to India's capital market Oil Rises as Mideast Tensions Flare With UAE-Iran Spat. Oil rose to the highest in almost three weeks, as US refiners ramped up crude consumption and a spat between the United Arab Emirates and Iran heightened regional tensions. Sebi bars two players from market over CAS 'trade manipulation'. rupees 3.67 crore to be impounded Wall St rises as yields ease, Moderna lifts healthcare stocks. USA-STOCKS/ (UPDATE 5):US STOCKS-Wall St rises as yields ease, Moderna lifts healthcare stocks Shiprocket, Behari Lal Engineering shares surge after strong market debut. Shiprocket and Behari Lal Engineering made strong market debuts, while Symbiotec Pharmalab set its IPO price band and Lalithaa Jewellery's issue saw 62.97x subscription Gold surges over 3 percent as US Treasury announcement hurts yields, dollar. GLOBAL-PRECIOUS:Gold surges over 3 percent as US Treasury announcement hurts yields, dollar Nifty extends fall to seventh session amid rising crude oil prices. HDFC Bank, ITC, HUL shares decline over 1 percent Target shares jump 6 percent as retailer raises full-year outlook on strong sales. The retailer now expects net sales to rise about 5 percent in the current fiscal year, which ends in early 2027. The new forecast is one percentage point above its previous guidance Small-ticket SIPs shrink as market volatility tests new investors. Folios with up to rupees 1,000 monthly inflows fell 1.4 mn in FY26; larger accounts grew Korean investors dump home stocks for US ones, buy same names at a premium Is KOSPI-style crash coming to Wall Street?. South Korean investors are shifting from their home market to US stocks amid waning confidence. July saw a net purchase of $4.5 billion in US stocks, primarily in technology and semiconductors. Ceigall JV wins road project of rupees 274 cr in State of Arunachal Pradesh. The project entails construction of road from km 17.812 to km 55.377 (Package-2) of Bile- Migging section (km 0.00 at Migging end) of NH 913 (Frontier Highway) to Intermediate Lane on EPC mode in the State of Arunachal Pradesh. India may see $1.5 tn family wealth shift. India anticipates a significant intergenerational wealth transfer exceeding one trillion dollars. HEG receives NCLT approval for demerger scheme; shareholders to get 1:1 shares in HEG Graphite. HEG has received approval from the NCLT for its demerger plan, creating two independent companies. Shareholders will receive one HEG Graphite share for each HEG share. The restructuring aims to offer differentiated exposure to graphite electrodes and advanced materials, enhancing long-term value. Sharp spike in international energy prices has had limited pass-through to domestic retail prices, says RBI minutes. RBI noted in its monetary policy minutes that as of June 2026, fuel inflation has remained modest because the sharp spike in international energy prices has had limited pass-through to domestic retail prices. CPI inflation has crossed the 4 percent target by small margin. However, core inflation was still below 4 percent . Core inflation excluding precious metals remained much lower at 2.5 per cent. Small towns drive India's connected TV growth. Connected TV households in India now number sixty-two to sixty-five million viewers. US dollar falls to lowest level since late May after Treasury doubles bond buybacks. The US dollar continues to decline, hitting multi-week lows as the Treasury doubles its debt buyback programme to stabilise the bond market. Yields have dropped amid heightened fiscal concerns and inflation, prompting a rally in longer-dated Treasuries. RBI monetary policy meeting minutes show cautious outlook on inflation, members highlight uncertain global enviornment. Reserve Bank of India (RBI) released minutes of sixty second meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) held during August 3 to 5, 2026 today. MPC member Nagesh Kumar noted that the Indian economy has displayed remarkable resilience in the face of challenging headwinds stemming from the ongoing conflict in West Asia, especially the volatility in crude oil prices, trade policy uncertainties, and agricultural risks arising from El Niño affecting the monsoons. The concerns arising from the West Asia conflict and the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz have not receded, even as India has made efforts to deal with the situation by diversifying the sources of supply. Trade policy uncertainties have been aggravated. Shiprocket lifts off: Fuel behind new logistics engine. Shiprockets strong stock market debut reflects surging investor confidence in Indias tech-driven e-commerce infrastructure. Sebi bars two entities from markets over manipulation in CAS, orders rupees 3.68 crore disgorgement. Sebi said Copthall Mauritius Investment and Mansi Share and Stock Broking had manipulated the closing auction session on 13 August, which was a weekly Sensex expiry day for derivatives contracts Healthy forex inflows to support INR stability: RBI minutes. RBI notes in the minutes of its August monetary policy that RBI has built a substantial dollar cushion to defend rupee. The central bank stated that the June 05th joint package of reforms by the RBI and the Ministry of Finance has received enthusiastic responses. In response to these incentives, as of July 31, 2026, a total of $36.725 billion has already been received under the FCNR(B) swap facility. Additionally, the bond market has witnessed healthy Foreign Portfolio Investment inflows through FAR. CBI registers case against BluSmart's founders. The CBI has filed a case against BluSmart founders. Metal stock to be in focus on Thursday after this Capex expansion update. Details here. Rhetan TMT's 1 MW solar power project in Gujarat has begun generating electricity for its manufacturing facility, reflecting the company's shift to operational sustainability.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Flexi-cap funds with highest and lowest large-cap stock allocation: What the data shows. Flexi-cap funds can vary sharply in their large-cap exposure despite having the flexibility to invest across market segments. Some of the biggest funds have a strong large-cap tilt, while others take a more diversified approach, creating an important distinction for investors to examine. Low-interest home loan with a fixed rate for years: Should you go for this new hybrid home loan?. Kotak Mahindra Bank introduced a hybrid home loan product for borrowers. This loan allows locking EMIs at current low rates for several years. After this fixed period, the loan automatically shifts to a floating rate structure. Borrowers can choose lock-in periods of 39, 52, or 65 months. Building a new house before selling the old one: Does Section 54 tax exemption apply? Rules explained. Starting construction before selling your old house does not automatically rule out the Section 54 exemption. Find out when the exemption can apply, the three-year completion rule, CGAS requirements, key risks and documents taxpayers should maintain. RAC train ticket became waitlisted, passenger had to travel standing; he filed a case against Railways and won rupees 5000 compensation. Man booked RAC-43 sleeper class ticket for rupees 399 to travel to village from Anand Vihar, however ticket's status was changed to waitlist after chart was prepared; he filed a case and won rupees 5000 compensation in Delhi State Consumer Commission. SBI slashes bulk fixed deposit rates: Will the latest changes affect your personal savings? Check here. SBI has reduced rates on domestic bulk term deposits by up to 25 basis points for select maturities. Switching from regular to direct mutual funds: Know the hidden tax cost , and when the move actually pays off. Regular and direct mutual fund plans can deliver different outcomes due to expense ratios, taxes and distributor costs. The decision to switch depends on factors such as the breakeven period and capital gains tax. Student Term Plan: With a big education loan and long repayment years, should you go for it?. Insurers are now offering term insurance plans specifically for students. These new plans provide affordable life coverage for young individuals. Coverage options extend for thirty to forty years, offering long-term financial security. Optional riders for critical illness and accidental death are also available. Latest SBI FD interest rates: State Bank of India has reduced rates by 25 bps on these fixed deposits. SBI FD interest rates: The State Bank of India implemented a reduction in interest rates for select bulk term deposits. This change specifically affects both general citizens and senior citizens, especially for shorter tenor deposits. SBI cash withdrawal charges: Bank changes BSBD free transaction rule; check what changed, rupees 15 fee and when it kicks in. State Bank of India has updated service charges for Basic Savings Bank Deposit accounts, effective October 1, 2026. 8th Pay Commission salary calculator: How 2.0-2.57 fitment factors may change Level 5-8 employees' basic salaries. 8th Pay Commission calculator: Starting in August 2026, the 8th Pay Commission will conduct meetings with stakeholders nationwide. Employee groups are advocating for a fitment factor greater than 3.8 to enhance their salaries. Contrary to these demands, experts project a more modest fitment factor ranging from 2.0 to 2.50 for the commission's recommendations, which holds considerable significance for the basic salaries of central government workers. JioBlackRock regular plans explained: Higher costs, professional guidance what investors get. JioBlackRock Asset Management will launch regular mutual fund plans through distributors, adding a route for investors who prefer support. Pledged gold jewellery stolen in bank robbery: Will bank repay full gold value, including making charges? Consumer commission answers. A man from Tumkur in Karnataka opened 2 gold loan accounts at a Canara Bank branch by pledging 2 items of gold each under both, in August 2017. The gold jewellery, kept in the custody of the Canara Bank branch, was robbed. On noticing the robbery of gold articles, the bank issued a letter dated July 26, 2018, to the borrower and offered to pay the gold value. Yet the borrower filed a complaint the District Commission. Technology funds bounced back in July: What investors should know before boosting their IT exposure. Technology mutual funds rebounded sharply in July, but the rally may not necessarily signal a sustained recovery. With IT allocation rising in mutual fund portfolios, investors should assess valuations, existing exposure and fund strategy before increasing their allocation. 8th Pay Commission: Can government amend 8th CPC terms of reference to include pension revision?. The Bharat Pensioner Samaj (BPS) and the All India Defence Employees' Federation (AIDEF) have recently written to the central government, seeking changes to the terms of reference (ToR) of the 8th Pay Commission. SBI customer alert: Basic savings account cash withdrawals beyond 4 times to attract rupees 15 charge from October 1. In an effort to revise its fee structure, the State Bank of India will enforce service charges on Basic Savings Bank Deposit accounts. Customers will be charged for cash withdrawals after four free transactions monthly, affecting all withdrawal methods, including online ones. These accounts are pivotal for fostering financial inclusion, as they have no minimum balance requirement and offer a free Rupay card. Investor versus trader: How stock market income is taxed, which ITR form to file and key conditions explained. Stock market investors and traders are taxed differently based on the nature of their activities. Both may also have to file different ITR forms. Here are the key rules, classification factors and common filing mistakes to know. Man constructs a house before selling his old property and claims income tax exemption under Section 54; Income Tax Department sends notice; he wins case in ITAT Delhi. Constructs house for rupees 47 lakh in Tilak Nagar, sells old property in Paschim Viharfor rupees 53 lakh, pays no tax, tax dept sent notice, man wins case in ITAT Delhi; Know how. This Paschim Vihar property was purchased on July 20, 2005 for rupees 6.48 lakh (including stamp duty). rupees 1 crore salary trap: Why high income does not equal financial freedom; CA identifies dangers of expensive lifestyle. CA Anil Sagayanathan highlights the fragility of high salaries and lifestyle inflation on LinkedIn. Even with rupees 1 crore income, financial stress prevails due to rising expenses and peer pressure. Form 146 for foreign remittances: Who needs a CA certificate and how taxpayers can file it , step-by-step guide. Form 146 is a CA-certified document for certain taxable foreign remittances. It helps determine the taxability and TDS applicable to overseas payments above the prescribed threshold. Here's when it is required, who files it and how taxpayers can use it. Foreign Asset Disclosure Scheme 2026: From budget proposal to rollout - what residents and NRIs need to know. The Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, 2026 has moved from Budget proposal to implementation. This article explains its two categories, tax and fee implications, eligibility for resident and present non-resident taxpayers, the rupees 20 lakh threshold, and key considerations for reviewing past foreign-asset reporting lapses under the Income-Tax Act, 1961 and the Black Money Act, 2015 Income tax return for social media creators: Last date, ITR forms, GST obligations and more. With the income tax return filing deadline approaching, creators who earn regularly through social media should ensure that their income and expenses are properly recorded. Career pivots are costly. How should parents plan for them?. While children tend to change interests and, in turn, career paths, the financial challenge of planning ahead remains: how do parents engineer an education fund that is flexible enough to accommodate possible changes in plans? SEBI eases entry process for mutual fund AMCs but retains strict checks: What investors should know. SEBI has simplified mutual fund registration by moving to a single application while retaining detailed checks on sponsors. Here's what the new framework means for investors evaluating a newly launched AMC and its funds. Earning rupees 2 lakh a month, but still feel broke? Run this 20-minute money audit, suggests investment adviser. High earners often feel financially stretched. Investment adviser Abhijit Kumar suggests a five-step financial audit to track spending and savings. Looking for stock tips? Here's a good one: don't ask an economist. An IIM professor explains why trying to pick individual winning stocks is a losing game, and why discipline and diversification are the real keys to long-term wealth.
